abstract: Installs, serves, tunes and troubleshoots TensorFold, a Zig LLM inference engine for Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs, with verified qualified-model limits, the two-Mac and two-DGX-Spark setups, and the community MiaAI-Lab recipes. References are split by install, serve flags, models, multi-node, features, API, tuning, integrations, observability, updating and troubleshooting.
